$comment: Prerequisites for a hackathon PARTICIPANT setting up opencode against the gateway. Run: pwsh scripts/preflight.json -Manifest scripts/preflight.json
title: Hackathon gateway - participant setup

checks.name: Node.js 20+
checks.fix: Install the LTS build from https://nodejs.org, then close and reopen your terminal.

checks.name: Gateway is reachable
checks.fix: Replace the URL in scripts/preflight.json with the address on your key card. If it still fails, check your internet or VPN. A 401 here is correct - it proves the gateway is alive and asking for a key.

checks.name: Gateway address is set
checks.fix: You set this in Step 2. It is normal for this to be missing before you start.

checks.name: Your key is set
checks.fix: You set this in Step 3. It is normal for this to be missing before you start.

checks.name: Model list in this folder
checks.fix: You copy this in Step 5. It is normal for this to be missing before you start.
